name: Rapha
overview: The name Rapha appears in Scripture associated with both individuals and a group linked to giants. In 1 Chronicles, Rapha is noted as a descendant of Jonathan within the tribe of Benjamin, also called Rephaiah, highlighting a lineage important to Israel's history. Conversely, in 2 Samuel, the term Rapha is connected to giants or men of great stature in Gath, including warriors with extraordinary physical traits, who opposed King David. These references collectively show Rapha as both a personal name in Israelite genealogy and a term connected to formidable Philistine warriors.
